data.gender_notes: Henrika is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: Power of the ruler, strong in mind
data.long_meaning: Derived from 'Henrik' which means 'ruler of the home'. Henrika is a strong name for a girl, meaning 'power of the ruler' or 'strong in mind'. In Christian tradition, it is the name of several saints, including Saint Henrika of the Fourteenth Century. The name Henrika carries the meaning “Power of the ruler, strong in mind” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Henrika usually hope their child will grow to embody power of the ruler, strong in mind and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Henrika belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Power of the ruler, strong in mind.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Henrika total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

data.cultural_impact: Henrika is a name rich in heritage, particularly in cultures with a strong Christian influence. As a variant of the name Henrik, which has historical significance as a powerful name for a ruler or leader, Henrika continues this tradition by bestowing the power of leadership on young girls. The name carries the idea of being a strong and capable woman, and is especially significant in cultures where the role of women is evolving, giving them more opportunities to significantly influence their communities.
data.spiritual_significance: With spiritual roots stretching back to the name Henrik, Henrika embodies the characteristics of a strong, capable leader. In the Christian tradition, each name holds a unique significance, and Henrika is no exception. As a variation of a traditionally masculine name, Henrika reflects the strength and power of God, inspiring girls to carry the spiritual attributes of courage, wisdom, and leadership. Additionally, Henrika pays tribute to the many saints bearing the same name, reminding us of their unwavering faith and devotion to God. Through the blessings and guidance of these sacred women, the name Henrika provides a spiritual foundation for girls, inspiring them to live lives of purpose, strength, and faith.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Henrika: God is my strength, ruler of my heart. Dedication to the power and grace of the Divine Feminine.
